description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different categories of knowledge as perceived by a language model, with the vertical axis representing popularity on a linear scale from 0 to 220. The horizontal axis categorizes the knowledge into three groups: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. Each category has a set of bars representing different levels of accuracy and ground truth answers, with the shortest bars indicating 'Acc=0 & GT Ans' and the tallest bars indicating 'Acc=1 & GT Ans'. The bars are color-coded, with 'Llama3' represented by blue, 'ChatGPT' by red, and 'Acc=0 & GT Ans' by a pattern of diagonal lines. The 'Acc=1 & GT Ans' bars are the tallest in the 'Basketball' category, indicating the highest popularity, while the 'Acc=0 & GT Ans' bars are the shortest across all categories. The chart does not provide any information on sorting or visual emphasis of the bars.
